title: Idle timeout 300 s (turns heaters off, keeps chamber drying macros working)

edits:
[idle_timeout]
timeout: 43200            
gcode:                   
    M118 Pause Timeout: Turn off heaters 
    #PRINT_END              
    M106 S0                
    M104 S0               
    M140 S0                
    M141 S0                 
    DISABLE_BOX_HEATER     
    _KM_IDLE_TIMEOUT       


[idle_timeout]
timeout: 300            
gcode:                   
    {% if printer['pause_resume'].is_paused %}
        M118 Pause timeout: turning off heaters
    {% else %}
        M118 Idle timeout: turning off heaters
    {% endif %}
    #PRINT_END              
    M106 S0                
    M104 S0               
    M140 S0                
    M141 S0                 
    DISABLE_BOX_HEATER     
    M84

[gcode_macro prepare_filament_dry]
gcode = 
    G28
    G1 Y260 F12000
[gcode_macro prepare_filament_dry]
gcode = 
    {% if printer.pause_resume.is_paused or printer.virtual_sdcard.is_active or printer.idle_timeout.state == "Printing" %}
        { action_raise_error("The printer is busy (print, pause or another task) - filament drying preparation is not available now") }
    {% endif %}
    G28
    G1 Y260 F12000
